propositions: The regex `_OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE` must accept both `[non-codebase]` and `[operator-attested]` spellings case-insensitively but reject underscore variants like `[operator_attested]`
Five consumers reference the shared compiled regex object; widening the pattern propagates the change to all five with no new branches introduced
The inverted-semantics consumer at `txn.py:547` must treat unchecked `[non-codebase]`-tagged AC items as close-exempt, matching the behavior for `[operator-attested]`-tagged items
The alternation in the regex must be non-capturing to prevent `findall()` from returning tuples instead of strings in Pass-3 enrichment
Widening the matcher cannot proceed until ADR-0101 (S8) is landed and officially defines `[non-codebase]` vocabulary
Existing tests must pass unchanged and new tests must verify both spellings work and that unchecked untagged items still block close
